content.value_statement: Teams need reliable AI guidance for Google Docs actions through the gws CLI. This skill explains how to inspect methods, create documents, read documents, and apply validated updates.
actual_capabilities: Shows the gws docs command pattern for resources, methods, and flags.
Lists document methods for batchUpdate, create, and get workflows.
Points users to gws schema for required parameters, types, and defaults.
Links to the companion write helper for appending text to a document.
Explains that batch updates validate requests before applying document changes.
limitations: Requires the gws binary and Google Workspace authentication.
Does not include the shared authentication skill content inside this file.
Does not list every Google Docs API method beyond the documents resource.
Does not perform actions by itself; it guides CLI usage.

use_cases.title: Create Meeting Documents
use_cases.description: Create blank Google Docs from AI-assisted workflows after confirming the title and account.

use_cases.title: Inspect Document Content
use_cases.description: Retrieve the latest document version before summarizing or editing shared content.

use_cases.title: Validate Update Requests
use_cases.description: Inspect schemas before sending batch updates that change document structure or text.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a blank Google Doc titled [title]. Inspect the create method schema first, then prepare the gws docs action.

prompt_templates.title: Read A Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the latest version of document [document ID]. Confirm the required parameters with gws schema before using the get method.

prompt_templates.title: Append Document Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Append [text] to document [document ID] with the companion write helper. Confirm the account and write intent before changing the document.

prompt_templates.title: Plan A Batch Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a batch update plan for document [document ID] that applies [change]. Validate the request structure before any write action.

output_examples.input: Create a new document for the Q3 planning notes.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies the create method, confirms the exact title, and prepares a clear Google Docs creation action.

output_examples.input: Get the latest content from an existing Google Doc.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks the get method requirements, asks for the document ID if needed, and retrieves the latest document version.

output_examples.input: Add a short status section to a shared document.
output_examples.output: The assistant confirms write permission, inspects the required schema, and prepares a validated update plan before changing the document.

best_practices: Inspect the method schema before each create, get, or batch update action.
Confirm the Google account, document ID, and write intent before modifying a document.
Keep document content user-approved and avoid sending unnecessary sensitive data.
anti_patterns: Do not guess document IDs or titles when the user has not provided enough context.
Do not send batch updates without checking the schema and expected request shape.
Do not use this skill to access documents outside the account the user authorized.

faq.question: Does this skill require authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. It depends on the gws CLI and Google Workspace authentication described by the shared gws skill.

faq.question: Can it create new Google Docs?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents the create method for blank documents using a user-provided title.

faq.question: Can it read existing documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents the get method for retrieving the latest document version.

faq.question: Can it update document content?
faq.answer: Yes. It points to batchUpdate and the companion write helper for document changes.

faq.question: Does it include every Google Docs API method?
faq.answer: No. This file lists the documents resource methods shown in the skill.

faq.question: Is it safe to run commands automatically?
faq.answer: Users should confirm account, document ID, and write intent before actions that read or change documents.
